definition: Technical and organisational work that moves applications, data or infrastructure to public cloud services delivered by commercial cloud providers. Includes migration discovery, dependency mapping, wave planning, landing zones, accounts and subscriptions, connectivity, identity integration, data transfer, workload migration, rehosting, replatforming, refactoring, repurchasing, retirement, testing, cutover, decommissioning, optimisation and use of public IaaS, PaaS or SaaS. Excludes cloud strategy without implementation, private or government cloud deployment, ordinary web hosting, and procurement of software that happens to be delivered online without an adoption or migration activity. Backup to public cloud is disaster_recovery unless part of a broader migration.
